intent: Trace the reported deaths over the years and compare the earliest and latest values to determine the overall direction of change.

requirements.question: Are all required line series shown in every declared panel?
What is the overall direction of change in reported deaths over the years, based on comparing the earliest and latest values?
The reported deaths decreased by 0.30 (from 0.75 to 0.45) between the earliest and latest points, a relative decline of 40%.

units.claim: All 1 required series appear in panel single chart.
accept: every required series is visible and correctly labeled in this panel
reject: series assigned to the wrong panel

units.claim: Reported deaths generally decrease over the years, from 0.75 at the earliest point to 0.45 at the latest point.
units.computation: Compare first_value (0.75 at point_order 1) and last_value (0.45 at point_order 33); the series shows a net decline.
accept: The line starts at 0.75 and ends at 0.45, indicating an overall downward trend.
Deaths decrease from the earliest to the latest year.
reject: The line shows an overall increase.
The earliest and latest values are equal.

units.claim: The reported deaths decreased by 0.30 (from 0.75 to 0.45) between the earliest and latest points, a relative decline of 40%.
accept: The value fell by 0.30, or 40%, from the first to the last point.
There is a net decrease of 0.30 between the earliest and latest values.

optional_valid: The minimum value is 0.40 at point_order 30, and the maximum is 0.75 at point_order 1.
unsupported_to_avoid: Causal explanations for the decline in deaths.
Specific year labels for the x-axis points, since x_values are empty.
review_notes: The intent asks to trace the trend and compare earliest and latest values; U1 covers the trend direction, U2 covers the quantitative change.
Only the first and last points are needed as basis for the overall direction and change; intermediate points are not required by the intent.
